exact: regulation of Wnt receptor signaling pathway through beta-catenin
regulation of canonical Wnt receptor signaling pathway
regulation of canonical Wnt receptor signalling pathway
regulation of canonical Wnt-activated signaling pathway
narrow: regulation of catenin import into nucleus
regulation of catenin protein nuclear translocation

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the Wnt signaling pathway through beta-catenin, the series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a Wnt protein to a frizzled family receptor on the surface of the target cell, followed by propagation of the signal via beta-catenin, and ending with a change in transcription of target genes.
label: regulation of canonical Wnt signaling pathway
